title: How a Man of God Keeps the Peace When His Family Fights at the Holidays
caption:
Every family has the table that goes sideways. The topic that always comes up. The person who always leaves early. The silence on the drive home.

You don't have to win that dinner. You get to lead it.

Let the bait go by. Go sit with the one in the garage. Own your part out loud, even if it's ten percent. Take thirty seconds in the hallway to pray before you walk back in.

The man who keeps the peace isn't the quiet one. He's the one who goes first.

"Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God." Matthew 5:9

Save this for the holidays. Send it to your brother who'll be at the same table.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #family #holidays
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
